scope: Capped builds, conversions, requantizations, server runs and paired accuracy as durable jobs of the task

units.checks: Argument checks per recipe, refused flags and paths, model runs only when the task allows them, node limits, the machine gate, host-only capped_run records, a fake build and serve end to end

limitations: The memory cap is a cgroup limit on the scope, not a reservation: the gate checks available memory first
A recipe is as good as the command it builds; the capsule verifiers judge what the run produced
